description: This file implements a server for the Minidroid test service, defining a class that inherits from aidl::com::android::minidroid::testservice::BnTestService and providing implementations for its methods. It sets up an RPC server and contains a main function that starts the service.

classes.name: TestService
classes.description: A class inheriting from aidl::com::android::minidroid::testservice::BnTestService that implements the test service methods.

methods.name: start_test_service
methods.description: Initializes and starts the test service by creating an instance of TestService and setting up the RPC server.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the program that logs a message and starts the test service.
